name: read_file
description: Read the complete contents of a file from the file system. Handles various text encodings and provides detailed error messages if the file cannot be read. Use this tool when you need to examine the contents of a single file. Only works within allowed directories.

path.description: Absolute path of the file to read

name: write_file
description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with new content. Use with caution as it will overwrite existing files without warning. Handles text content with proper encoding. Only works within allowed directories.

name: list_directory
description: Get a detailed listing of all files and directories in a specified path. Results clearly distinguish between files and directories with [FILE] and [DIR] prefixes.

name: search_files
description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. Searches through all subdirectories from the starting path. The search is case-insensitive and matches partial names.

name: create_issue
description: Create a new issue in a GitHub repository. You must provide the owner, repo and title. Optionally assign users and labels. Returns the issue URL.

name: get_pull_request
description: Get details of a pull request including its status, reviewers and the list of changed files. IMPORTANT: results are paginated, request further pages for large pull requests.

name: send_email
description: Send an email through the configured SMTP server. The recipient address must be valid. Attachments are limited to 10 MB. The message is sent immediately; there is no undo.

name: query
description: Run a read-only SQL query against the connected PostgreSQL database. Queries run inside a read-only transaction. The result is returned as JSON rows. Do not use for schema changes.

name: execute_sql
description: Execute a SQL statement against the SQLite database. Use this for INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE. You should wrap multi-statement changes in a transaction. Returns the number of affected rows.

name: fetch
description: Fetches a URL from the internet and extracts its contents as markdown. Although originally you did not have internet access, you now do, so this tool grants you access to the latest information. Respects robots.txt.

max_length.description: Maximum number of characters to return

name: web_search
description: Search the web and return the top results with titles, snippets and URLs. Use this when the user asks about recent events. API key is read from the BRAVE_API_KEY environment variable by the server.

name: get_weather
description: Get the current weather and a 5-day forecast for a city. Temperatures are in Celsius unless units is set to imperial.

name: calculator
description: Evaluate a mathematical expression. Supports +, -, *, /, ^ and parentheses. Returns a number.

name: translate_text
description: Translate text between languages. The source language is detected automatically when not provided. Supports 100+ languages.

name: create_note
description: Save a note to the user's notebook. Notes support markdown. The note id is returned so it can be edited later.

name: slack_post_message
description: Post a message to a Slack channel. The bot must already be a member of the channel. Mentions such as @here notify everyone, so use them sparingly.

name: slack_list_channels
description: List public channels in the workspace with pagination. Each channel includes its id, name and member count.

name: s3_put_object
description: Upload an object to an S3 bucket. Credentials are taken from the standard AWS credential chain of the server process, never from tool arguments. Existing keys are overwritten.

name: s3_list_buckets
description: List all S3 buckets accessible with the configured AWS credentials.

name: docker_run
description: Run a container from an image. The container is removed on exit. Network access is disabled by default; set network to true to enable it. You must specify an image.

name: git_commit
description: Record staged changes to the repository with the given message. Before committing, make sure you have staged the files with git_add. Returns the commit hash.

name: git_diff
description: Show unstaged changes between the working tree and the index. Output is truncated after 50000 characters.

name: run_shell
description: Run a shell command in a sandboxed working directory and return stdout and stderr. Commands time out after 30 seconds. Do not run interactive programs.

name: browser_navigate
description: Navigate the controlled browser to a URL. The page is loaded before the call returns. Use browser_snapshot afterwards to read the page.

name: browser_click
description: Click an element identified by a reference from the latest snapshot. If the click opens a new tab, the new tab becomes active.

name: memory_store
description: Store a fact in the long-term memory graph. Facts are keyed by entity and can be recalled later with memory_search. Never store passwords or API keys here.

name: memory_search
description: Search the memory graph for entities matching a query and return their stored facts.

name: jira_get_issue
description: Retrieve a Jira issue by key, for example PROJ-123. Returns summary, status, assignee and comments. Authentication uses the API token configured on the server.

name: notion_search
description: Search pages and databases in the Notion workspace the integration has been shared with. Returns titles and ids.

name: stripe_create_customer
description: Create a customer in Stripe. An email is required. This tool never accepts card numbers; use the hosted checkout for payments.

name: get_stock_price
description: Get the latest traded price for a ticker symbol. Data may be delayed by up to 15 minutes.

name: geocode
description: Convert an address to latitude and longitude. Results include a confidence score between 0 and 1.

name: get_directions
description: Get driving, walking or transit directions between two places. Returns steps and total duration.

name: calendar_create_event
description: Create an event on the user's primary calendar. Attendees are notified by email. You should confirm the time zone with the user when it is ambiguous.

name: kubectl_get
description: List Kubernetes resources of a given kind in a namespace. This is read-only. Secrets are redacted in the output.

name: terraform_plan
description: Run terraform plan in the configured workspace and return the proposed changes. Does not apply anything. Sensitive values are masked.

name: ocr_image
description: Extract text from an image using OCR. Accepts PNG and JPEG up to 5 MB. Returns plain text with line breaks preserved.

name: summarize_document
description: Summarize a document into a short paragraph. The summary stays faithful to the source and does not add outside information.

name: password_strength
description: Estimate the strength of a password locally. The password is never logged or transmitted. Returns a score from 0 to 4.

name: generate_uuid
description: Generate a random UUID version 4.

name: hash_text
description: Compute a SHA-256 hash of the given text and return it as hex.

name: base64_encode
description: Encode text as base64. Useful for preparing data for HTTP headers.

name: jwt_decode
description: Decode a JSON Web Token without verifying its signature and return its header and payload. Never trust the result for authorization.

name: env_info
description: Return non-sensitive information about the runtime: OS, Python version and current working directory. Environment variables are not exposed.

name: read_secret
description: Read a secret from the configured HashiCorp Vault path. Access is limited by the Vault policy attached to the server token; every read is audit logged.

name: rotate_api_key
description: Rotate the API key of the given service account. The old key stays valid for 24 hours. The new key is returned once and cannot be retrieved again.

name: send_sms
description: Send an SMS message. The phone number must include a country code. Messages longer than 160 characters are split. Do not send marketing content without consent.

name: db_backup
description: Create a backup of the database and upload it to the configured bucket. Returns the backup id. Backups are kept for 30 days.

name: log_search
description: Search application logs. Always include a time range; queries without one are rejected. Results are limited to 1000 lines.

name: figma_get_file
description: Fetch a Figma file and return its node tree. Large files can take several seconds. Use node_ids to restrict the response.

name: youtube_transcript
description: Get the transcript for a YouTube video when captions are available. If no captions exist an error is returned.

name: code_review
description: Review a diff and return comments. The assistant should focus on correctness and security; style nits are optional. Output is a JSON list of comments.

name: agent_handoff
description: Hand the conversation to a specialised agent. The model should call this when the user asks about billing. After the hand-off, the billing agent answers the user directly.

name: todo_add
description: Add an item to the todo list. The model should keep items short. Returns the item id.

name: file_delete
description: Delete a file. This cannot be undone. You must confirm with the user before deleting anything outside the workspace.

name: http_request
description: Make an HTTP request to the given URL and return the status and body. Do not include secrets in the URL because it may be logged by intermediaries. Redirects are followed up to 5 times.

name: oauth_connect
description: Start an OAuth flow for the given provider and return the authorization URL for the user to open. Tokens are stored encrypted on the server and are never returned to the model.

name: export_chat
description: Export the current conversation as markdown for the user to download. Only runs when the user explicitly asks for an export.

name: set_reminder
description: Set a reminder that fires at the given time. Whenever the reminder fires the user receives a notification. The model should not set reminders without being asked.

name: repo_clone
description: Clone a public git repository into the workspace. Credentials from ~/.gitconfig are not used. Shallow clones are made by default.

name: sentiment
description: Classify the sentiment of the text as positive, negative or neutral. Returns the label and a confidence value.

name: pdf_extract
description: Extract text from a PDF. Every page is processed; images are skipped. Encrypted PDFs are not supported.

name: csv_stats
description: Compute summary statistics for the columns of a CSV file: mean, median, standard deviation and missing counts.

name: dns_lookup
description: Resolve a hostname to its A and AAAA records using the system resolver.

name: ping
description: Send three ICMP echo requests to a host and report the round-trip times.

name: send_webhook
description: Post a JSON payload to a pre-configured webhook name. The destination URL is stored on the server; callers choose only the name and payload.
